scripts.docker:bridge:recreate: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.mac.yml build canon-bridge && ./scripts/docker/kill-stuck-bridge.sh; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.mac.yml up -d --no-deps --force-recreate canon-bridge
scripts.docker:usbip:recreate: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.mac.yml build usbip-attach && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.mac.yml up -d --force-recreate usbip-attach
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.mac.yml stop -t 3 photobooth 2>/dev/null || true; ./scripts/docker/kill-stuck-bridge.sh 2>/dev/null || true; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.mac.yml down --timeout 3
